items.name: Battle Axe
items.description: These axes are designed explicitly as weapons, rather than tools. They typically weigh less, with a shaft reinforced with metal bands or bolts, and have a sharper blade, making them ideal for chopping limbs rather than wood.

items.name: Half Plate
items.description: Half plate consists of most of the upper body plates used in full plate, with lighter or sparser steel plate protection for the arms and legs. This provides some of the protection of full plate with greater flexibility and speed. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Padded Armor] and a pair of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Gauntlet]{gauntlets}.

generalAbilities.name: Easily Misled
generalAbilities.description: The forest troll gets a –4 circumstance penalty to their Perception DC against Deception checks.

ac.note: (26 plus all-around vision after Shed Armor)

defensiveAbilities.name: Regeneration 20 (Deactivated by Electricity or Fire)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Furious Roar
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The troll warleader takes electricity or fire damage

Effect The warleader uses their Primordial Roar and, if they're aware of the damage's source, can Stride toward it. If the warleader has persistent fire damage, they attempt a DC 15 Flat to remove it.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Primordial Roar
offensiveAbilities.description:
The troll warleader unleashes a bestial roar. Each non-troll creature in a 100ft Emanation must attempt a DC 29 Will Saving Throw save. The creature is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 3.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shed Armor
offensiveAbilities.description:
The warleader cuts their armor loose from their flesh. They immediately heal 60 Healing Damage{60 Hit Points} in a surge of regeneration as they grow twisted limbs and malformed faces.

Without their armor, the warleader's AC drops to 26 but they gain All-Around Vision from the new faces.

Putting the armor back on takes 10 minutes, and this ability can't be used again until 1 hour has passed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sweeping Axes
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The troll warleader is wielding two battle axes

Effect The warleader makes a battle axe Strike against each creature in their reach and the bonus from sweep applies to each attack. These attacks count against their multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.
